facts.label: Desculpas e motivos
facts.sub: Use I’m sorry e o passado simples para explicar: I missed my train. Ligue o motivo com because: I was late because my alarm didn’t ring.

facts.label: Pedir desculpas
facts.sub: Para pedir desculpas, use I’m sorry ou I’m so sorry. Depois diga o motivo: I was late because I missed my train. É educado e natural. Um simples sorry funciona, mas o motivo ajuda o amigo a entender.

facts.label: Porque
facts.sub: Because liga o motivo ao fato: I was late because my alarm didn’t ring. Depois de because use sujeito + verbo. Para perguntar o motivo, use Why: Why were you late? Why did you miss it?

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We say “I’m late because I missed the train”.
The past of miss is missed.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We say “I’m late because I missed the train”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “because of I missed”. → Falso (We say because I missed.)
The past of miss is missed. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a busy cafe in Leeds. Cups clink and people talk. Kara sits at a table and looks at her watch. The door opens fast. Her friend Ben runs in with a red face. Kara looks up.
“Ben! You’re late. I waited for thirty minutes.” says Kara. “I’m so sorry, Kara. I was late because I missed my train.” says Ben. “Why did you miss it?” says Kara.
